claims.statement: Default is Spring physical naming: camel case and dots become underscores, lowercase (PetType -> pet_type), with or without explicit @Table name.

claims.statement: Supported physical strategies are Spring (default), standard Hibernate and CamelCaseToUnderscores; custom PhysicalNamingStrategy classes are listed separately.
claims.supports: Spring (default), the standard Hibernate implementation, CamelCaseToUnderscores; custom classes in a custom section

claims.statement: Migration scripts apply the same naming strategy as runtime.
claims.supports: Migration scripts apply the same naming strategy to match runtime names
